subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The archive showed that progress is not always a straight line.”?
options: A map can help people understand the world, but it can also quietly teach them where they think the center is.
Looking back can teach people what they gained and what they should not lose.
When knowledge burns or vanishes, future people lose questions they might have asked.
A building that once divided people can later teach them about connection.

本文可直接核對「The archive showed that progress is not always a straight line. Looking back can teach people what they gained and what they…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「When knowledge burns or vanishes, future people lose questions they might have asked.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The archive showed that progress is not always a straight line. Looking back can teach people what they gained and what they should not…」，答案為「Looking back can teach people what they gained and what they should not lose.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Looking back can teach people what they gained and what they should not lose.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
